findings.title: Title menu box blending with background
findings.where: Title screen, the dark rectangular menu box containing 'New Driver' and 'Controls'
findings.problem: The menu box uses a near-black background with minimal transparency, making it visually merge with the dark desert backdrop instead of standing out as an interactive element.
findings.why: Players may overlook the menu entirely, delaying game start and reducing perceived polish; critical navigation elements must immediately draw attention in the first 3 seconds of gameplay.
findings.fix: Add a 4px opaque black background behind the menu box with 90% opacity, keeping only the cyan border visible to create strong visual separation from the background.

findings.title: Radar lacks threat visibility
findings.where: Arena and road screens, the circular radar in bottom-left corner
findings.problem: The radar sweep and contact blip use identical dark green tones with no size or brightness differentiation, making threats indistinguishable from the radar background.
findings.why: In combat scenarios, players need instant threat assessment; ambiguous radar feedback forces excessive screen scanning and increases cognitive load during high-pressure moments.
findings.fix: Render contact blips as solid white dots 30% larger than the sweep, with a pulsing outer glow when within 50m range to create immediate visual priority.

findings.title: Critical condition text low contrast
findings.where: Arena and road screens, right-side 'CONDITION' panel, specifically 'Body armor: x 0/3' line
findings.problem: The critical red text for missing body armor uses a dark maroon (#8B0000) against near-black panel background, resulting in less than 2:1 contrast ratio.
findings.why: Players may miss vital vehicle damage states during combat, leading to preventable destruction; critical warnings must be instantly legible without conscious effort.
findings.fix: Change critical status text to pure red (#FF0000) with a 1px white outer stroke, maintaining the same font size but ensuring 4.5:1 contrast minimum.

findings.title: City road path ambiguity
findings.where: City screen, the circular road segments forming the main route
findings.problem: The road is rendered as disconnected white segments with large gaps, failing to communicate a continuous navigable path and resembling damaged pavement rather than a route.
findings.why: Players may attempt to drive through non-traversable areas, causing navigation errors and breaking immersion; clear pathing is essential for first-time map comprehension.
findings.fix: Replace dotted segments with a solid white center line and add 30% brighter yellow shoulder markers at consistent intervals to define the drivable corridor.

findings.title: Empty weapon slots illegible
findings.where: Constructor screen, left panel weapon list (Weapon 1-10 rows)
findings.problem: The '(empty)' text uses dark gray (#333333) against black background, creating 1.5:1 contrast ratio—well below WCAG readability standards for interface text.
findings.why: Players cannot quickly identify available slots while building, slowing progression and causing missed equipment opportunities during critical customization phases.
findings.fix: Change empty slot text to #555555 (medium gray) with 1px black outline, matching the contrast level of 'Subcompact' part names to maintain visual consistency.
